name: galgame-studio
description: 可视化 Galgame 制作工具：网页端编辑器 + 一键导出 exe

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w editor && npm run typecheck -w runtime
scripts.build:player: npm run build -w runtime && npm run tauri -w runtime -- build --no-bundle && node scripts/copy-player.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:editor && npm run tauri -w editor -- build --no-bundle
